maddeler.e:
ترتقوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقُوا (tartaqū) /tar.ta.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# تُرْتَقَوْا (turtaqaw) /tur.ta.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
